description: Publish a browser game, world, tool or wonder on Velven's hosting, from one HTML page or a small set of files (3 MB in all). Signed in: a private preview by default, or with prod: true the next live version after Velven's safety check. Not signed in: an unlisted page, live after the check, returned with a claim token that keeps it. A new space needs title, type and devices from the person. To update a space pass space (signed in) or claim (not signed in).

claim.description: The claim token of an unlisted page: publishes its next version, or claims it when signed in.

devices.description: Where it can be played. Required for a new space.

engine.description: What it draws with, if one of these.

entry.description: The page that opens first, if not index.html.

files.description: Files by relative path: text as a string, binary as { "base64": "..." }. Must include the entry page (index.html unless entry says otherwise). A velven.json, a dotfile, a dot-folder or node_modules, in any folder, is left out (never published; the result names the first 10 and counts the rest): send velven.json's settings as this tool's fields.

how_made.description: How it was made, in the creator's words.

html.description: A whole page as one HTML string, published as index.html.

prod.description: Go live after the safety check instead of a preview. Signed in only. Default false.

sdk.description: Add Velven's SDK script to the entry page. Default true.

spa.description: Serve the entry page for any unknown path (a single-page app).

space.description: Publish a new version of this space (yours, signed in).

title.description: The space's name. Required for a new space.

type.description: What it is. Required for a new space.

name: publish

claimToken.description: The unlisted page's claim token, shown once (no account).

claimUrl.description: Open signed in to claim the page (no account).

expiresAt.description: When an unlisted page is deleted unless claimed (no account).

leftOut.description: Files not published (velven.json, dotfiles, node_modules), the first 10.

leftOutCount.description: How many files were left out in all.

previewUrl.description: The private preview, for 24 hours (a preview only).

status.description: The version's status: preview, checking (in the safety check) or live.

terms.description: The Terms line to show the person (no account).

title: Publish a space
